LEFT JOIN REQUEST AS RQ ON RQ.rqidx = A.rqidx
LEFT JOIN BOOKS AS B ON B.bidx = COALESCE(A.bidx, RQ.bidx) WHERE A.delyn = 'N'

SELECT B.* FROM APPROVAL AS A LEFT JOIN REQUEST AS RQ ON RQ.rqidx = A.rqidx LEFT JOIN BOOKS AS B ON B.bidx = COALESCE(A.bidx, RQ.bidx) WHERE A.delyn = 'N' and aidx = #{aidx}

UPDATE APPROVAL SET status = #{status}, rejectionReason = #{rejectionReason}, approvalDate = now() WHERE aidx = #{aidx}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(A.bidx, R.bidx) AS bidx, B.coverImg, B.title, B.originalTitle, B.subTitle, B.author, B.introduction, B.publisher, DATE_FORMAT(B.publishedYear, '%Y.%m.%d') AS publishedYear, B.totalPages, B.isbn, B.sizeWidth, B.sizeHeight, B.weight, B.category, A.aidx FROM APPROVAL AS A LEFT JOIN REQUEST AS R ON A.rqidx = R.rqidx LEFT JOIN BOOKS AS B ON B.bidx = COALESCE(A.bidx, R.bidx) WHERE A.delyn = 'N' AND (B.delyn = 'N' OR B.delyn IS NULL) AND A.aidx = #{aidx}
